summary: Frontend-only validation for mandatory drawer-connection gating + Dashboard layout re-arrangement. All 8 requested checks PASSED (100%). Layout order top→bottom confirmed via getBoundingClientRect: disconnected-banner (y=104) → QuickActions/action-in (y=286) → BalanceCard+ShiftControl grid (y=439, balance left x=184, shift right x=993) → txn-log (y=738). Quick Actions all three buttons (IN/OUT/ADJ) are disabled while drawer is offline, and the [data-testid='quick-actions-hint'] displays 'Connect the cash drawer in Devices to record transactions.'. Shift Control button is disabled with label 'Connect drawer to close' (an open shift from a previous run was present in DB). Banner 'Connect Device' opens the Devices dialog. Reports and Users (staff) dialogs open normally in read-only mode. Clicking the disabled Shift button does NOT open shift-open-dialog or shift-close-dialog. Zero console errors and zero page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx correctly gates QuickActions with disabled={!shift || !drawerConnected}, so read-only mode is enforced whether the drawer is offline OR no shift is open.
ShiftControl.jsx uses BOTH the disabled attribute AND a guard()/toast fallback — belt-and-suspenders. Label switches contextually via drawerConnected ternary.
QuickActions.jsx hint text intelligently branches on the reason (shift missing vs drawer disconnected), giving the operator the correct next-action prompt.
The disconnected-banner is only rendered when !drawerConnected — clean conditional, no layout jump when connected.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for this UI test
seed_data_creation: None. Existing open shift from prior run (#f00c2e0e opened ₹3,000 by Amit Kumar) was present; did not interfere.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Headless Playwright cannot exercise real Web Serial/WebUSB — drawerConnected stays false, which is exactly the read-only path this iteration validates. Physical pulse-before-write behavior in ShiftOpenDialog/ShiftCloseDialog/TransactionDialog must be validated on a workstation with a real thermal printer. All test-ids from the request are stable and used.
